items.name: Jerk Chicken with Pineapple Salsa
items.desc: This is just the dish you need to transport you to somewhere tropical, even if you can't quite yet get there in real life. Starting with a sweet/spicy/tangy marinade and ending with a delicious, pineapple salsa, this dish is delish start to finish!

items.name: Chicken Pot Pie Gnocchi
items.desc: Just like grandma used to make...if grandma was an Italian living in Iowa! It's a spin on two comfort food classics, both lightened up but heavy on delicious flavor.

items.name: Roasted Sweet Potato Black Bean Salad
items.desc: Healthy and filling, this salad combines some amazing southwestern flavors to keep you full and happy! Perfect for lunch on the go, it's also available with chicken.

items.name: Roasted Sweet Potato Black Bean & Chicken Salad
items.desc: Healthy and filling, this salad combines some amazing southwestern flavors to keep you full and happy! Perfect for lunch on the go, it's also available without added protein.

items.name: Sunrise Omelet Bites
items.desc: Looking for an on-the-go breakfast? High in protein and flavor, these little bites are a super combo of fluffy eggs, red bell peppers, tasty sausage, and seasonings that will make your life easier and tastier!

items.name: Tuscan Ribollita Soup
items.desc: Italian comfort food at its finest! This creamy, full-flavored vegetable soup makes simple taste simply delicious!

items.name: Everything Bagel Snack Box
items.desc: Packed with nutrition and all the delicious flavor of the Everything Bagel Seasoning blend, this snack box is a great way to switch up your snack game!

items.name: Take & Bake Chicken Pot Pie Gnocchi (6 servings)
items.desc: Creamy, comforting, and putting a spin on two comfort food classics, both lightened up but heavy on delicious flavor.
